description: Validates the exact developer-live authority contract: v22 with every rule, binding, bound, tool, declaration and refusal unchanged, except that authorityBasis also names ADR 0091 and every rule's source.admittedInputs is owner-designated-public-samplebooks-under-adr-0043-and-adr-0091 — the Owner-designated Public SampleBooks of ADR 0043 (exact sample1) and the four public-domain works ADR 0091 admits, each by its exact bytes and SHA-256 in SampleBooks/README.md.

localTools.description: AI7's local targeted-retrieval tool for this rule: it reads only the sources the Run was authorized to read (the pinned Manuscript Revision, 允许参考 items at their frozen index version, retained sources) and returns at most 8 ranked candidates with anchors per call, at most 5 calls per Run unit; a citation needs an Exact Fetch of the pinned revision; scope no-egress (nothing is sent outside the process); a breaker ends a unit after 128 consecutive tool round trips with 检索未完成. Calls and tokens count into the Run Budget Ceiling.

authorityOrigin.description: Review admits standard-direct and default-execution-rule origins: a newly user-initiated Task may use review quick start under its matching active Default Execution Rule. Background enrollment, schedules, import triggers and cross-Run dispatch remain refused.

platformTools.description: AI7's platform tools for this rule: websearch through the one backend the user selects among the five shipped backends (default the first, the recorded top rank), each named by id, host, endpoint, development broker slot and the development Credential Reference its provider document fixes; webfetch at most 5,242,880 bytes and 30 seconds per page, only for addresses the model cites; a breaker that ends a unit after 128 consecutive tool round trips with 联网核查未完成; one search query per Run unit; tool results are public-or-synthetic. Only the model's own query reaches the search host.

sourceTranslationAllowed.description: The review rule that researches the web may also have a retained external source's passage translated into Chinese (来源译文) by the Run's own model, labelled machine translation, never replacing the original; the term is stated on this rule alone, and only the developer-live selection acts on it.

const.descriptionZh: 本社审阅偏好摘录：由本社编辑自己对审阅发现已作出的判断（采纳、改后采纳、忽略并说明理由）归纳出的类别偏好行与理由短语，随审阅请求一并发出。每次请求至多 12 行、合计至多 200 个字素；必须标明所依据的偏好记录版本；绝不含稿件正文，绝不含作者或编辑姓名；开发直连下只取自已获准的公开或合成图书（Owner 指定的公开样书）。

houseReviewPreference.description: The category's declaration, stated on the review rule alone: the house's review preference block is derived only from judged review decisions of the same house, carries at most 12 lines and 200 graphemes in total, names the record version it rests on, never holds manuscript text, author names or editor names, and comes only from admitted public-or-synthetic Books. 本社审阅偏好摘录的声明：仅此审阅规则载明。

const.descriptionZh: 书系知识摘录：本次审阅冻结的书系范围所固定的书系知识条目版本，按书系一致性审阅已有的条款边界切成条款，随审阅请求一并发出。每次请求至多 40 条、每条至多 300 个字素；只取自本次审阅固定的那些书系的条目；已生效的书系检索排除一律遵守，被排除的条目不发出；必须标明所依据的条目版本；开发直连下只取自已获准的公开或合成图书所在的书系（Owner 指定的公开样书）。

seriesKnowledgeExcerpt.description: The category's declaration, stated on the review rules alone: Series Knowledge item revisions pinned by the Run's frozen Series scope, cut into at most 40 clauses of at most 300 graphemes each as the 书系一致性 review already bounds them, only items of the pinned Series, honouring every Series Retrieval Exclusion frozen in the Run, naming the item revisions they rest on, and only from admitted public-or-synthetic Books. 书系知识摘录的声明：仅审阅规则载明。

authorityOrigin.description: Writing alone admits standard-direct and default-execution-rule origins: a newly user-initiated Task may use writing quick start under its matching active Default Execution Rule. Background enrollment, schedules, import triggers and cross-Run dispatch remain refused.

transmissions.description: The Coverage Manifest bounds unit requests and safe retries; plusOneCrossUnitSynthesisTurn adds exactly one book-level synthesis request (全书综合 / 综合). crossUnitSynthesisAllowed is true only for writing and the three evaluation contracts and is carried into the per-rule launch projection. No assurance sample; one Run Report reflection turn remains separate from synthesis. plusClarificationAnswerTurns adds at most one answer turn for each model question the editor answers (one question per unit).

authorityOrigin.description: Only an active matching Background Analysis Enrollment admits this origin, and each dispatch creates one exact Run; no new Task is required and a Default Execution Rule, a provider setup, an import or an artifact enablement never creates an enrollment. Dispatch happens in idle or quiet time.

localTools.description: Enrolled background analysis uses no model-initiated retrieval: targetedRetrieval.allowed is false. The remaining terms are stated so the block reads the same as every other rule's.

clarification.description: A background Run may ask the same single clarification question per unit; the unit waits (holding no background slot) while other units continue, and an unanswered question ends as 不回答 after the timeout, disclosed in the Run Report.

authorizationPreconditions.description: The enrollment must state a tokens ceiling; an unset ceiling is refused. A Series or all-Books enrollment splits that ceiling equally across the Books it schedules, the remainder going to the first Book in the scope's Book order. Background Runs hold at most capacity minus one concurrent slots, so a foreground Task always keeps one.

const.descriptionZh: 编辑自拟的单元提问模板：编辑在知识库「工序与规则」里为一个自定义分析维度写下的、对每个单元提出的问题模板，随该维度每个单元的请求一并发出。每个模板至多 400 个字素；必须标明所依据的分析维度版本；绝不含稿件正文，绝不含作者或编辑姓名；它只是 AI7 固定的分析合同里一个有边界的数据参数，绝不改写或覆盖 AI7 的合同框架。

editorAuthoredQuestionTemplate.description: The category's declaration, stated on the custom analysis rule alone: the per-unit question template is an editor-authored text from a 工序与规则 document, at most 400 graphemes, attributed to the exact custom analysis dimension version, never manuscript text and never an author's or editor's name, and only a bounded data parameter of AI7's fixed contract framing, never an override of it. 编辑自拟的单元提问模板的声明：仅此自定义分析规则载明。

clarification.description: Model-initiated clarification: at most one question per unit; the unit waits for the editor while other units continue; after the timeout the question counts as unanswered and the Run Report discloses it.
